title: html2lvgl sidecar overrides
description: A `<page>.lvgl.json` file next to a page: attribute changes, removals and (version 2) structure operations applied to the generated widget tree by widget `name`. Mirrors validateOverrides() in src/overrides.mjs, which stays the authority; tests/sidecar-schema.test.mjs checks the two agree. One rule the schema cannot express: a non-empty `structure` needs `version` 2 (a sidecar with only attribute changes stays version 1 so older converters can read it).

version.description: 1: attribute overrides and removals. 2: also the `structure` list. The editor and the preview API write the lowest version that fits.

nodes.description: Widget name (the generated `name` attribute) to its override.

structure.description: Adds and moves, applied in order to the tree the operations before them produced, before `nodes`. `parent` is a widget name, or null for the page; `index` is the place among the parent's children (for a move, with the widget already taken out); past the end means the end. See src/overrides-structure.mjs.

attrs.description: Values replace or add attributes; null removes one. A key is letters, digits and underscores with an optional LVGL state suffix, as in `style_bg_color:pressed`; `name` cannot be overridden. A key that breaks these rules is not a validation error: applying the sidecar skips it and reports OVERRIDE_ATTR_INVALID.

remove.description: Delete the node and its subtree.

tag.description: An LVGL widget tag such as lv_label.

parent.description: The name of the widget that holds it, or null for the page. Only lv_obj and lv_button (and the page) can hold widgets.

moveOperation.description: Move an existing widget to another place.
